headerDisplay: Fireplaces are exposed as separate accessories. Each fireplace needs a static IP address configured on your network.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable to log every status poll while the fireplace is running. Idle (off) polls are never logged. When disabled, only status changes are logged.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Static IP address of the fireplace WiFi controller

auxFan.title: Auxiliary Fan
auxFan.description: Enable only if this fireplace has the optional aux fan kit. When disabled, the fan (SwingMode) control is hidden in HomeKit and no aux commands are sent.
